1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer added Text based ATC clauses BUYER ADDED BID SPECIFIC ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) Name of the work: Training and Awareness Programme for the year 2026-27. 1. Scope of Work The selected service provider shall organise and provide the necessary arrangements for the following acti vities as directed by the Office of the District Fishery Development Officer, Bajali. i) Two (2) one-day Training and Capacity Building Programme. ii) One (1) Awareness-cum-Launching Programme for Fish River Ranching. The service provider shall arrange the venue, seating, banner/backdrop, public address system, stationery and participation materials wherever specified, refreshments, photography, documentation and other nec essary logistical arrangements as per the approved scope of work and the instructions of the purchaser. The tentative participant strength and specific requirements for each programme shall be communicated by the purchaser before the respective event. 2. Price Quotation The bidder shall quote the price inclusive of all applicable taxes, transportation, manpower, materials, ven ue arrangements, refreshments, equipment, documentation and all other incidental expenses required for satisfactory execution of the work. No additional payment shall be admissible for expenses that should reasonably have been included in the quoted price, subject to the terms of the GeM contract. 3. Eligibility and Experience The bidder should have at least two (2) years of experience in providing similar services, such as organisin g training programmes, workshops, seminars, awareness programmes or comparable event-management services. The bidder shall submit documentary evidence in support of the claimed experience, such as work orders/ contracts and corresponding completion certificates or equivalent documentary evidence establishing sati sfactory completion. Work Orders/Contracts alone shall not be accepted as proof of work experie nce. The submitted documents should clearly indicate the nature of the service, name of the client, period of ex ecution and completion status. 4. Documents to Be Submitted The bidder shall upload the following self attested documents, as applicable and permitted un der the GeM bidding conditions: 1. PAN card. 2. Valid Trade Licence. 3. GST registration certificate. 4. Income Tax Return for the preceding three financial years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-2 6, subject to applicable legal and GeM requirements. 5. Work orders/contracts alongwith completion certificates or equivalent evidence in support o f the required experience. 6. Item wise Price Breakup (MS-Excel uploaded alongwith this Bid) in both MS-Excel format an

d in sealed and signed pdf format. 7. Any other document expressly required under the GeM bid or these ATC, provided such req uirement is consistent with the applicable GeM terms and conditions. All submitted documents shall be legible, valid and duly authenticated wherever required. 5. Execution of Work The service provider shall execute the programmes on the dates, at the venues within two nos Developme nt Block jurisdiction of Bajali district and in accordance with the instructions communicated by the purchas er. The service provider shall ensure: a. Timely arrangement of the venue and seating facilities. b. Proper display of the approved banner/backdrop. c. Functional public address system and other equipment required for the programme. d. Supply of stationery, participation materials and other items specifically included in the approved scope of work. e. Arrangement of refreshments for the approved number of participants and officials. f. Photography and preparation of the necessary event documentation. g. Compliance with instructions issued by the purchaser concerning the conduct and successful completion of each programme. Any change in the date, venue, participant strength or other material arrangements shall be undertaken i n consultation with and with the approval of the purchaser. 6. Evidence of Completion After completion of each programme, the service provider shall submit the relevant supporting documents as required by the purchaser, which may include: a. Photographs of the programme and arrangements. b. Attendance sheets or participant records, wherever maintained. c. Copies or samples of banners, stationery and participation materials, wherever applicable. d. A brief completion report describing the activities conducted. e. Invoice and other documents required for processing payment. The purchaser may verify the satisfactory execution of the work before issuing acceptance. 7. Payment Terms Payment shall be processed in accordance with the applicable GeM contract conditions and the prescribed Government financial procedures, subject to satisfactory completion and acceptance of the services, subm ission of the required supporting documents and availability/receipt of the requisite financial sanction, whe rever applicable. Payment shall be subject to applicable statutory deductions and other requirements under the prevailing r ules. 8. Non-Compliance Failure to meet the essential eligibility requirements, submission of materially incorrect or misleading docu ments, or failure to comply with the contractual scope and conditions may result in rejection of the bid or o ther action permissible under the applicable GeM terms and conditions. Any such action shall be taken in accordance with the applicable procurement rules and contractual provis

ions. 9. General Conditions The service provider shall comply with all applicable laws, statutory requirements, Government instruction s and the terms and conditions of the GeM contract. In the event of any inconsistency between these ATC and the applicable GeM General Terms and Condition s, the applicable GeM provisions shall prevail. All requirements under this ATC shall be interpreted and implemented in a manner consistent with the app licable GeM bidding rules and Government procurement guidelines. The DFDO, Bajali reserves the right to accept or reject any bid or cancel the bidding process at any stage, without assigning any reason thereof, in the interest of the Council.
